You can safely make contact.''"<br />"''Thank you, I thought you'd be at Yarille by now.''"<br />"''And we thought you needed a hand. Can we help in any way?|Ash Jarvee and Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="No Prisoners" />}}
'''Ash Jarvee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Altisian Jedi]], an unorthodox Jedi sect that was led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jarvee and a number of other Altisian Jedi were dispatched aboard the [[Vernal-class freighter|freighter]] ''[[Wookiee Gunner]]'' on a mission to administer humanitarian aid on the war-ravaged [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Yarille]]. En route, the Jedi detected a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Spy/Legends|agent]] [[Hallena Devis]], and a number of Jedi from ''Wookiee Gunner'' transferred to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Leveler]]'', to assist in the [[Battle of JanFathal|extraction]] of Devis from the planet [[JanFathal]]. Jarvee was left in command of ''Wookiee Gunner'', and under her lead the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] departed for Yarille. A short time later, the crew of ''Wookiee Gunner'' tracked ''Leveler'' to the [[Poressi system/Legends|Poressi system]], and Jarvee boarded the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] along with a number of other Jedi, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to remedy a problem with ''Leveler''{{'s}} [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]]. She then traveled with ''Leveler'' to the [[Fath system]], where the warship successfully extracted Devis and a Republic strike team from JanFathal. Afterward, Jarvee returned to ''Wookiee Gunner'', and the freighter [[Transport/Legends|transported]] Jarvee and the other Altisian Jedi to Yarille.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jedi Jarvee, Propulsion&mdash;stand by to get us out of here as soon as the transport's inboard and the bay is secure.|Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="No Prisoners" />}}
[[File:Gilad3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gilad Pellaeon, the commander of the Republic warship ''Leveler'']]
Ash Jarvee was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Within the Order, Jarvee became one of the [[Altisian Jedi]], a rogue Jedi sect led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Djinn Altis]] that was considered by orthodox Jedi to be heretical. Altis [[Jedi training/Legends|taught]] Jarvee a number of [[Force power/Legends|Force techniques]], and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;a conflict fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;Jarvee was in her teens. The Altisian Jedi did not join the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and assist the Republic war effort directly, as had the Jedi Order proper, and instead they unofficially helped the Republic by providing humanitarian relief to worlds affected by the war.<ref name="No Prisoners" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a number of the Altisian Jedi were dispatched aboard the [[Vernal-class freighter|''Vernal''-class freighter]] ''[[Wookiee Gunner]]'', on a mission to administer aid to the inhabitants of the war-ravaged [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Yarille]]. Jarvee accompanied the mission, and she acted as a section commander among the crew of ''Wookiee Gunner''. En route, ''Wookiee Gunner'' detected a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] that had been sent by the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Spy/Legends|agent]] [[Hallena Devis]] from the planet [[JanFathal]], and Altis contacted the nearest Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]],<ref name="No Prisoners" /> the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]<ref name="Republic 64">[[Republic 64|''Republic'' 64]]</ref> ''[[Leveler]]'', to offer the assistance of his Jedi in extracting Devis. [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of ''Leveler'', agreed to the Jedi Master's proposal, and ''Wookiee Gunner'' rendezvoused with ''Leveler''. Altis and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Callista Ming|Callista Masana]] and [[Geith Eris]] transferred to the Republic [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and in their absence Jarvee was left in command of ''Wookiee Gunner''. The Jedi [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] then departed from the rendezvous point, to resume its course to Yarille.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

A short time afterward, Altis, Eris, Masana, and a Republic strike team landed on JanFathal to [[Battle of JanFathal|rescue]] Devis, while ''Leveler'' jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to evade the Separatist [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] [[Reaper (destroyer)|''Reaper'']]. ''Leveler'' arrived in the [[Poressi system/Legends|Poressi system]] and became stranded as a result of technical problems relating to the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. ''Wookiee Gunner'' tracked ''Leveler'' to the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and approached the Republic warship, and Jarvee contacted Pellaeon to offer him the help of ''Wookiee Gunner''{{'s}} remaining Jedi. Pellaeon informed her that ''Leveler''{{'s}} communications encryption had been breached, so Jarvee contacted the Republic's [[Naval Command (Galactic Republic)|Naval Command]] and obtained a new set communications codes. She then re-opened communications with Pellaeon and volunteered the use of the Jedi's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities, to influence the malfunctioning navicomputer.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

Pellaeon agreed to Jarvee's proposal, and she boarded ''Leveler'' with a delegation of Altisian Jedi. After speaking to Altis via a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], to inform him that she had made contact with ''Leveler'', Jarvee explained to Pellaeon the details of how the Jedi planned to use an esoteric Force technique to influence the [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Jarvee and the other Jedi then stood in a circle around the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] with clasped [[Limb/Legends|hands]], and they used the Force to influence the navicomputer into taking ''Leveler'' back to the [[Fath system]]. Altis, Devis, and the strike team landed on ''Leveler'', and Pellaeon told Jarvee that he planned to mention her in dispatches, to commend her for aiding ''Leveler''. Masana then [[Essence transfer|merged]] her consciousness with the ship's computer system and used [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] to destroy the Separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] bearing down on ''Leveler'', and Jarvee and the other Jedi subsequently used their powers to influence the navicomputer again, to help ''Leveler'' to leave the Fath system.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

''Leveler'' dropped Jarvee and the other Altisian Jedi off at a [[Kemla Yard|shipyard]] on the planet [[Kemla]], where ''Wookiee Gunner'' was to rendezvous with them. While they waited, Jarvee sat with Masana, and the pair discussed Masana's recent experiences in the Fath system. ''Wookiee Gunner'' eventually arrived and took Jarvee and the other Jedi to Yarille, landing in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Yen Bachask]]. There, Altis assigned Jarvee, Masana, and ''Wookiee Gunner''{{'s}} other female section commanders to be the first group of Jedi to disembark from the freighter and make contact with the local population, because he believed that an all-female delegation would make the Jedi seem friendly. The party approached a nearby refugee camp, where they were greeted by a group of the world's inhabitants, who [[Handshake|shook hands]] with Jarvee and her comrades.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do you think that combat binds us tighter than everyday friendships because it's a defense mechanism? That we've evolved to stick together with the beings most likely to fight to defend us?''"<br />"''That's a very&hellip; machine-like view.''"<br />"''You're laughing at me now.''"<br />"''Not at all. But I'd rather think that we bond more strongly in adversity because we see others for what they really are&mdash;prepared to die to save us, rather than run away.|Callista Masana and Ash Jarvee|<ref name="No Prisoners" />}}
Ash Jarvee was excitable and became elated when the Jedi successfully used their Force powers to bring ''Leveler'' to the Fath system. However, she felt embarrassed when Gilad Pellaeon told her that he would mention her in dispatches. Jarvee believed that people bonded well when placed in difficult situations, because such circumstances allowed individuals to see what those around them truly were.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Master Altis has taught us some useful Force techniques that he's discovered on his travels.|Ash Jarvee|<ref name="No Prisoners" />}}
Djinn Altis taught Ash Jarvee and the other Altisian Jedi a number of Force powers that he had learned while traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One such power, which Jarvee used to help ''Leveler'' enter hyperspace, allowed a group of Jedi to influence the performance of a navicomputer, and the technique was considered to be a rare ability amongst the Jedi.<ref name="No Prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ash Jarvee was created by [[Karen Traviss]], and she appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''.<ref name="No Prisoners" />
